subject.title: refactor(mac): make app node a CLI capability superset

question: After the two correctness blockers are fixed, what signed-app evidence is required to accept that the private worker preserves macOS approval and TCC enforcement?
rationale: Unit tests cannot establish process attribution, permission enforcement, and upgrade/reconnect behavior across the new child-process boundary.

options.title: Require full signed-app diagnostics
options.body: Hold merge until redacted evidence demonstrates exact-version startup, reconnect, effective approval output, and TCC-sensitive execution.

options.title: Accept narrower live observations
options.body: Accept the described `system.which` and denied `screen.snapshot` checks after they are posted as inspectable diagnostic output.

recommendation.title: Require full signed-app diagnostics
recommendation.body: Hold merge until redacted evidence demonstrates exact-version startup, reconnect, effective approval output, and TCC-sensitive execution.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature and recent Mac runtime history make this person the strongest available owner for the signed-app acceptance decision.
